headline: A model of which sanction margins deter, fitted WITHOUT Hansen, predicts deterrence at both his thresholds and classifies all three margins (0.08, 0.15 ≥, 0.15 >) as CONSISTENT with the 001 re-analysis — the newer prosecution/jail 'criminogenic' studies act on a general-crime record channel, not Hansen's DUI experienced-severity margins.

metrics.label: OOS test — Hansen 0.08 (predict deter)
metrics.note: Severity + DUI-record classes both deter; 001 point negative, A1 CI excl 0.

metrics.label: OOS test — Hansen 0.15 (predict deter)
metrics.note: Cleanest experienced-severity DUI margin; strict A1 CI excl 0, statutory bw-dependent. Branch N: do-files not obtained.

metrics.label: Record-change margin splits by domain
metrics.note: This domain split is why the new 'criminogenic' studies do NOT contradict Hansen.

metrics.label: Jail-day effect — UPPER BOUND (jail-only channel)
metrics.note: Upper bound: Hansen's margin bundles conviction+fines+treatment, so dividing the whole effect by jail days overstates it.

tables.title: Out-of-sample prediction of Hansen's margins (model fitted without Hansen)
Sign model — which margin classes deter (post-2015, Hansen excluded)

figures.caption: Relative effect of the harsher sanction on reoffending, by study, coloured by margin class, with Hansen's 001 estimates (A1 RBC + A2 honest CIs) highlighted in orange. Severity/certainty (blue) and DUI record (green) deter; general-crime record (vermillion) is criminogenic; Hansen's margins are negative — all three classified consistent.
figures.alt: Forest plot: severity and DUI-record studies left of zero (deter), general-crime record studies far right (criminogenic), Hansen 001 estimates negative with confidence bars

figures.caption: Utah .05–.07 share of reported-BAC DUI arrests, FY2016–2025. The share doubles after the .05 law (mean 4.7%→10.1%), but the rise is partly mechanical (newly-arrestable drivers), not deterrence.
figures.alt: Bar chart of Utah .05-.07 arrest share by fiscal year, low pre-law, rising after the 2018 law line

notes: '001' input is the completed continuation study followup/002-methods-and-transport (the 001- dir was cut short/empty); status completed.
Branch N: 0.15 carried under both codings (openICPSR do-files not obtained).
Structured synthesis, not a meta-analysis; regression descriptive only (n=7<8, H8), sign model carries inference.
Classification tests SIGN (no admissible regression prediction interval). Hansen's relative effects sit on the small end of the severity cluster (high-base 4-yr DUI-test outcome).
Agan & Mueller-Smith–Schnepel values are sign-convention conversions of published non-prosecution/diversion effects.
